metadata.description: Open-source Claude Code skills, agents, and plugins by Dilmun — a software & design studio.

plugins.name: transcript-cut
plugins.description: Edit raw talking-video/voice-over footage by its transcript — cut filler words, silences, retakes at word-boundary precision. Fully local and key-free (whisperX + ffmpeg), Arabic-first.

plugins.name: karaoke-captions
plugins.description: Arabic-first word-timed karaoke captions + voiceover in one pass — edge-tts word timing, no speech recognition, no GPU, no API key. Outputs mp3, words.json, RTL-safe burnable .ass, and Remotion captions.json.
